utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive — I’m still a little foggy, but I can come help sort donations and set up the tables in about twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be a huge help, Oren — thank you. I’ll let Cleo know you can be here in about twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Nell. I’ll head over in about twenty minutes and do my best to keep my head on straight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still taking inventory, and I’ll let you know what we’re short on as soon as I finish.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know what you’re short on, and I’ll bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah — I’ll finish the inventory and send you the list of what’s missing soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll send over the timing and drop-off spots right away, and I’d love to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll swing by this afternoon and see if they still need another helper. If they do, I’ll save you a spot!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — appreciate it. Let me know if they still need help, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive and can help sort donations and set up the tables. If you need me, I’ll head over in about twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Mara — thanks for helping out. See you in about twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll head over then and get started on the donations and tables.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time are we meeting today?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let’s meet at 10 a.m. at the community center parking lot so everyone can gather there easily.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, 10 a.m. at the community center parking lot—just confirming, that’s still the plan for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I’ll double-check the schedule and see if we need any extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Please send the schedule and list when you can, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check in this afternoon and send you the schedule plus the supply list. If they still need another helper, I’ll save you a spot!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — I’m just finishing these errands, then I’ll swing by and check in on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll wait for you at the community center parking lot. Just let me know when you’re on your way so I can keep track of where everyone’s meeting.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — I’m heading over as soon as I wrap up these errands and I’ll let you know when I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll point out the broken pieces and then we can sort them once we get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just let me know what’s missing, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll show you the missing parts first, then we can gather the broken pieces and head over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring a screwdriver and a wrench, and I’m happy to help for a bit if you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, Rey — thank you. I’ll let everyone know we’re set and keep it coordinated around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the details and deadline soon, and I’ll keep the drop-off info clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll repeat the plan to folks nearby and keep it clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring the gloves and trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Mina — thanks! I’ll send the full list around, and if you find anything tricky, just set it aside and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll set anything tricky aside and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d still need the exact timing and a clear list of what repairs are included before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll send over the exact list and timing so it’s clear before you commit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Dane — that works for me. Once you send the timing and the repair list, I can check whether I’m able to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, I can bring a screwdriver and maybe a wrench. If they still need help, I’m happy to stop by for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help — could you send me the exact timing and what repairs are included? Then I can see if I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have the exact timing yet, but I’ll check and send it over as soon as I know. It sounds like mostly small fixes, plus they need a few tools and extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll send the addresses along as soon as I have them, and I’ll keep sharing any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time are we meeting today?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m aiming for 2 PM today at the community hall — does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m still planning to check in this afternoon and see if they need another helper. If they do, I’ll save you a spot!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great, Tess — thanks for keeping an eye on it. If they need another helper, I’m happy to jump in and help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Aww, thanks, Jules — that’d be a huge help. I’ll check in this afternoon and let you know right away if they still need another helper.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening today—can you remind me what time we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by and repeat the plan to folks nearby, and I’ll bring a few tools to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — could you also confirm the meeting time and the exact spot?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring a few gloves and some trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina — that’s really helpful. I’ll swing by after these errands and let the others know what’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — see you then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—so it’s the repair drive, and I can still bring something by soon. Just point me to what needs moving, and I’ll help sort it out when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — that’d help a lot. I’ll send over the list and point you to the easiest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks. Send me the list when you can, and I’ll take a look at the easiest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 to 5:00 works for me — I can plan around pickup and let the other parents know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll pass that along and send the full list so everyone can plan ahead. Thanks, Faye!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Quinn — once you send the list, I’ll help spread the word to the other parents.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive, and I can help sort donations and set up the tables. If you’re heading over soon, I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara. I’m heading over now, and I’d really appreciate the help sorting donations and setting up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll head over now and meet you there. We can start with the donations and then get the tables set up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam — Saturday morning at the community center works for me. I’ll bring my gloves and a couple of tools, and please send the list so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send the list over right away. Really appreciate you bringing your gloves and tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Sam — I’ll watch for it and plan around Saturday morning. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so what’s the latest on the repair drive? I’ll keep an ear out for any extra screws, tape, or a drill.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell — 3:30 to 5:00 after school. I’m starting at the scrap pile by the shed, and extra screws, tape, or a drill would help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll tell folks the time and the scrap pile by the shed, and I’ll keep an eye out for extra screws, tape, or a drill.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details and deadline soon, and keep the drop-off info clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll wait for the details and deadline before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll send them soon and keep everything organized so it’s easy to jump in when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Twenty minutes works for me — I’ll head to the hall and help sort the donations and set up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — swing by when you can and I’ll pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I’ll head over in a bit and help wherever I can. Hopefully I remember the table setup this time.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
